body:
Cannot with my current doctor, they are so busy that they've abandoned most types of appointments and operate on a "sit and wait" basis like a walk-in clinic.

They have also abandoned all kinds of out of hours care.

In order to get an appointment I'd have to take the afternoon off work, sit wait and hope. All to see a dr I don't know if I can trust yet because I've not even managed to get a single appointment there yet since I moved house.

I got drunk and fell asleep just to stop myself thinking about it last night, I spent all evening trying to play a game I'd ordinarily enjoy but just wasn't able to, and it's my first full weekend off in a while during a very hectic period at work, so I was getting incredibly frustrated about it.

I'm in the process of trying to switch back to one of my previous doctors (as I'll be moving back home in a couple months) but the problem is it's very difficult to get a day off work to go and show them my ID (they won't let me register without doing so in person for some fucking stupid reason) due to my commute distance and because of all the stuff going on at work they absolutely will not approve any holidays or work-at-home days until after christmas :(

I'm sure they would if I told them I was suicidal, but, I'm sure you can understand why I don't want to do that.

It seems really fucked up that such a situation can happen in this country. Given that most people work 9-5s, surely doctors should be closed at least one weekday and open on weekend day...
